scraped.scraped_description: We connect governments, civil society and business to open up and monitor public procurement. Open contracting results in fairer deals and less corruption.

name: Open Contracting Partnership
tagline: Open, fair & efficient public contracting to improve US$2 trillion in annual public procurement spending
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on government adoption and political will
Data quality dependent on implementing countries' capacity

news_articles.headline: A remedy for medicine procurement: How Brazil is improving decision-making in a $75 billion market using open data and AI
The UK Procurement Act one year on: what does the data tell us?
Three strategies for designing an e-procurement system: Lessons learned in Nuevo León, Mexico

academic_citations.title: Open Contracting and Public Procurement Transparency: Evidence from Implementation in Emerging Markets
Transparency in Government Procurement: The Role of Open Data Standards
academic_citations.venue: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory

policy_outcomes.description: UK Procurement Act implementation influenced by open contracting principles
Brazil's medicine procurement system ($75 billion market) adopting open data and AI based on OCP guidance
E-procurement system design in Nuevo León, Mexico informed by OCP strategies

outcome_methodology: Mixed methods including case studies, government adoption tracking, and procurement data analysis across implementing countries
published_performance_metrics: $17 billion better spent, 19 million people served in 2025
documented_limitations: Outcome attribution challenges due to multiple concurrent reforms; data quality varies significantly by country; limited long-term impact studies; difficulty isolating OCP's specific contribution from broader transparency initiatives
failure_modes: Government resistance to transparency in some jurisdictions; insufficient technical capacity for data implementation in lower-income countries; political changes reversing procurement reforms; limited private sector engagement in some markets
curation_criteria: Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) compliance; government commitment to implementation; civil society participation; technical capacity assessment; alignment with anti-corruption objectives
contributor_governance: Multi-stakeholder governance board including government representatives, civil society, private sector, and international organizations; open contribution process for technical standards development
disparity_tracking: Monitoring procurement transparency gaps between high-income and low-income countries; tracking women-owned business participation in procurement; analyzing geographic disparities in contract value distribution
community_ownership: Government ownership through formal adoption of OCDS; civil society co-implementation in monitoring and advocacy; private sector participation in data standards development
controversies: Concerns about data privacy in some jurisdictions; debates over appropriate level of contract disclosure; tensions between transparency and commercial confidentiality
legal_regulatory_issues: Data protection compliance challenges under GDPR and similar regulations; varying legal frameworks for public procurement transparency across countries; intellectual property considerations for proprietary procurement data
ai_involvement: Yes - AI used in Brazil's medicine procurement decision-making system
political_relevance_summary: Open Contracting Partnership addresses the civic need for government transparency and open data access, enabling citizens, journalists, and researchers to hold public institutions accountable.

movement_building_utility.notes: Open Contracting Partnership amplifies civic advocacy by giving citizens and groups tools to engage in democratic processes or influence policy.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. Open Contracting Partnership is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
